purpose: Refit the T195 redistributable three-laboratory primary route after collapsing technical replicate rows before outer splitting, nested selection, model fitting and negative-control permutation.

target_universe.availability_rule: A common target contributes only when the audited source map records a finite strictly positive author value; blank, explicit zero and NA states remain missing.

technical_replicate_policy.fit_unit: one collapsed target observation per source/batch/canonical-target group
technical_replicate_policy.target_value: arithmetic mean of available positive technical-replicate source-local rank percentiles
technical_replicate_policy.feature_value: release-fixed sequence feature vector for the canonical accession
technical_replicate_policy.missingness: Do not impute absent replicate rows; average only observed positive rows in a registered duplicate group.

models.constant: development-target mean; Spearman is undefined by contract
models.full: unpenalized-intercept ridge on the release-fixed sequence feature table
models.composition_only: unpenalized-intercept ridge on amino-acid composition features only
models.standardization: development-partition mean and standard deviation; zero standard deviation replaced by 1.0

uncertainty.low_cluster_count_policy: Report measurement-batch count and do not infer donor-level effective n.

negative_control.alpha_policy: re-run grouped nested alpha selection for every permuted development set

estimand_boundary: Primary score is the equal-weight mean of source-local measurement-batch Spearman values after technical-replicate collapse. Report raw rows, collapsed fit units, duplicate groups, batches, laboratory anchors and unresolved donor-level effective n separately.
claim_boundary: This is an exploratory replicate-aware refit of the redistributable T195 paper-data primary route. It does not establish independent biological validation, donor-level generalization, protected lockbox performance, no-author reproduction, external adoption, DOI archival or scientific submission readiness.
